circle back: I'm hoping you'll forget about this.
let's take this offline: Stop talking in front of my boss.
touch base: I need you to know I'm watching.
move the needle: Do something my boss will notice.
low-hanging fruit: The stuff we should have done months ago.
synergy: Two teams, one budget. Somebody is getting cut.
leverage: Use. I just wanted a longer word.
deep dive: A meeting that will last three hours and change nothing.
action item: Something you now have to do and I don't.
going forward: You messed up and we both know it.
boil the ocean: Your idea is too much work for me.
net-net: Here's the part I actually care about.
socialize the idea: Get enough people to agree that it's not my fault if it fails.
put a pin in it: This idea is dead. We are just being polite at the funeral.
run it up the flagpole: I'm not allowed to decide anything.
paradigm shift: We changed one thing and made a slide about it.
core competency: The only thing we're not bad at.
open the kimono: Show me the numbers you're hiding. (Also, please stop saying this phrase.)
ping me: Interrupt me later instead of now.
ooo: Please do not contact me. I will see your message and ignore it.
hard stop: I'm leaving whether this is finished or not.
level set: Let me explain this slowly, for some of you.
game changer: A small update with a big press release.
best practices: What we copied from a competitor.
pain points: Things customers have complained about for years.
quick win: Something to put in my performance review.
on my radar: I've seen it. I'm not doing it.
30,000-foot view: I don't know any of the details.
